release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.17 makes every player stack clickable to toggle table amount labels between USD and BB, and moves the upper/lower seat rows to keep hole cards from obscuring the displayed stack. Casino now opens in a dedicated reusable window instead of occupying the main app page. Punto Banco Baccarat now reveals every dealt card with a deliberate corner-peel squeeze animation, including third cards, and hides totals/results until reveal completes. Existing Blackjack/Baccarat rules, casino wallet and ledger behavior, the one-time $270 UI-test refund marker, NL500/NL1000, the immutable 174-situation preflop chart, postflop reasoning, and Hold'em Run It Twice are preserved.
